feed.title: Rail Vision Advances AI-Powered Tech in MxV Rail's U.S. Locomotive Sensor Testing Program (NASDAQ: RVSN)
feed.summary: Rail Vision (NASDAQ: RVSN) has been selected to participate in MxV Rail's locomotive sensor pre-integration testing program, focusing on Restricted Speed Enforcement. The initiative is part of the TCCO Technology Roadmap Program, connecting Rail Vision's technology with broader rail automation efforts.

feed.title: General Motors (GM) Has One Operational US EV Battery Plant
feed.summary: General Motors (GM) now has only one operational US electric vehicle battery plant, reflecting a shift in its North American manufacturing strategy. This move suggests GM is prioritizing profitable trucks and near-term cash generation, potentially slowing its EV progress in North America, a key point for investors to consider.
